title: The Gromov--Ros conjecture for rank-one symmetric spaces of noncompact type
summary: We prove the Gromov--Ros conjecture for every rank-one symmetric space of noncompact type: finite-perimeter isoperimetric regions are precisely the geodesic balls, up to ambient isometry and null sets. The proof is organized uniformly in the root multiplicities $(p,q)$. We introduce the volume radius \[ R(r)^n=n\int_0^r\sinh^{n-1}s\,\cosh^q s\,ds, \] which converts the polar volume form into $R^{n-1}dR\,dσ$.
